preview.text: Zimbabwe Women face West Indies Women in a T20 match at Takashinga Sports Club, where the usual first-innings score in the 6 recorded T20 matches is 122. West Indies Women won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 31 per cent chance of rain and about 22 degrees.

summary.text: West Indies Women won their match by 8 wkts after restricting ZIMW to 106-7, with Beloved Biza scoring 35 off 35 balls and Jahzara Claxton taking 3 for 14. In response, WIW reached 108-2 thanks to Eboni Brathwaite with 57 off 23 balls, while Christine Mutasa claimed 1 for 15.
